status.decider: Funding carry (delta-neutral)

idea.name: Funding carry (delta-neutral)
idea.blurb: Hyperliquid perps vs spot · collects funding · market-neutral · kill 95%
idea.source: Schmeling, Schrimpf & Todorov, 'Crypto Carry' (BIS WP 1087 / Management Science); Hyperliquid funding docs
idea.rule: Daily at 00:00 UTC: for coins whose 7-day average funding is above 15% a year (up to 6, richest first), buy spot and short the same amount of perp; keep while funding stays above 5%. Price moves cancel, the book earns the funding longs pay shorts.

backtest.caveat: Sharpe is flattered by the smooth hourly premium used as the basis proxy; real risks are tail events (short-squeeze margin calls, venue risk) and a yield that has been shrinking.

boost.why: spot-funded delta-neutral: spot cannot be levered and the book is already fully deployed - fresh $10k only

status.decider: Alt/BTC cross trend (market-neutral)

idea.name: Alt/BTC cross trend (market-neutral)
idea.blurb: Altcoins priced in BTC · trend-following · BTC-hedged, beta ~0 · BOOSTED x5 to its growth peak · kill 95%
idea.source: Moskowitz, Ooi & Pedersen, 'Time series momentum' (JFE 2012); Menkhoff et al., 'Currency momentum strategies' (JFE 2012); Liu & Tsyvinski, 'Risks and Returns of Cryptocurrency' (RFS 2021)
idea.rule: Daily at 00:00 UTC: for each altcoin, price it in BTC and average the trend sign over 10/20/42/84 days (-1..+1). Long the alt perp when its BTC cross trends up, short when it trends down, sized to 20% vol per cross / 21 alts; the BTC perp takes the opposite of the net alt exposure (market-neutral).

backtest.caveat: Weak edge: the direction calls beat random ones (p=0.03) but the Sharpe interval includes zero and the last two years were flat (Sharpe -0.06). On probation - it earns its place on paper or gets retired. Uses only ~36% of the book gross, so returns are small by design.

boost.why: backtest: x5 -> 7.9%/yr, max DD 48.1% (growth peak x4.5 = 7.9%/yr)

status.decider: Vol-managed crypto momentum v2 (market-neutral, bear-market guard)

idea.name: Vol-managed crypto momentum v2 (market-neutral, bear-market guard)
idea.blurb: Weekly winners minus losers · sized by momentum's own recent volatility · BOOSTED x5 to its growth peak · kill 95%
idea.source: Grobys, Kolari, Sandretto, Shahzad & Aijo, 'Cryptocurrency momentum has (not) its moments', Financial Markets and Portfolio Management 39(4) 2025; Barroso & Santa-Clara, 'Momentum has its moments', JFE 2015
idea.rule: Mondays 00:00 UTC: rank coins by 30-day return (skip the latest day); long the top fifth, short the bottom fifth, equal weight; scale the book by 20% / its own realised vol over the last 8 weeks (max 2x); v2: flat while the equal-weight coin index is down over the last 60 days.

backtest.caveat: On probation. The paper's key claim - that volatility scaling improves crypto momentum - did NOT replicate on our coins (scaled 0.51 vs unscaled 0.66). The winner/loser picks beat random ones only weakly (p=0.07), the Sharpe interval includes zero, and it lost money in 2025 and 2026. Backtest drawdown 42.5% would have tripped this book's 30% kill switch in 2025.

boost.why: backtest: x5 -> 50.6%/yr, max DD 73.2% (growth peak x5 = 50.6%/yr)

status.decider: Breakout Rocket v2: Donchian breakout ensemble (leveraged, BTC-regime gated)

idea.name: Breakout Rocket v2: Donchian breakout ensemble (leveraged, BTC-regime gated)
idea.blurb: Nine channel breakouts per coin · trailing stops · only while BTC is above its 100-day average · 80% vol, up to 4x · BOOSTED x2.25 to its growth peak · kill 95%
idea.source: Zarattini, Pagani & Barbon, 'Catching Crypto Trends; A Tactical Approach for Bitcoin and Altcoins', SSRN 5209907 (2025): Donchian ensemble over nine horizons, BTC net Sharpe 1.56, CAGR 30%, max DD 19% at a 25% vol target; top-20 rotation ~11%/yr alpha over BTC
idea.rule: Daily 00:00 UTC: for each coin run nine breakout systems (5-360 days): long on a close above the prior L-day high, out on a close below the trailing channel midpoint. Signal = share of systems long, counted only while BTC closes above its 100-day average (v2); size by 1/60-day vol; scale the book to 80%/yr vol, max 4x gross.

backtest.caveat: v2 (2026-10-07) adds a BTC 100-day-average gate: 50-125 days all helped, 150-200 hurt, so the gate works only while it is fast - a choice made with hindsight on one 6-year history. v1: Max risk by design: at this setting the backtest fell 82.5% peak-to-trough and lost 24.5% over the last 12 months (BTC -28.5%); returns stop growing above ~80-100% vol, so this is the top of the dial, not a step on the way up. The kill switch fires at -85%. Coins are today's Hyperliquid survivors, which flatters a long-only result. 0.83 correlated with Strategy 1. The long/short version did NOT replicate (Sharpe 0.78, short leg -12%/yr), so it is long-only.

boost.why: backtest: x2.25 -> 299.2%/yr, max DD 96.3% (growth peak x1.75 = 332.3%/yr)

status.decider: 52-week-high momentum (market-neutral)

idea.name: 52-week-high momentum (market-neutral)
idea.blurb: Long the coins pinned near their yearly high · short the ones far below it · BOOSTED x2.75 to its growth peak · kill 95%
idea.source: George & Hwang, 'The 52-Week High and Momentum Investing', Journal of Finance 59(5) 2004; Ficura, 'Impact of size and volume on cryptocurrency momentum and reversal', Prague University of Economics and Business WP 2023/5
idea.rule: Mondays 00:00 UTC: PTH = last close / 52-week high for coins with a full year of data; long the top 30% by PTH, short the bottom 30%, equal weight, 0.5x equity per side.

idea.name: Absorption Ratio: out of crypto when coins move as one (3x)
idea.blurb: Measures how much of all 22 coins' risk is one shared move (top principal components) · when that share jumps vs its past year, go to cash; when it drops, all in · equal-weight long basket · daily · 3x · kill 95%
idea.source: Kritzman, Li, Page & Rigobon, 'Principal Components as a Measure of Systemic Risk', Journal of Portfolio Management 37(4) 2011, 112-126
idea.rule: Daily 00:00 UTC: AR = share of variance in the top 1/5 eigenvalues of the 500-day EW (half-life 250) covariance of daily returns; shift = (15-day mean AR - 1-year mean AR) / 1-year std. shift >= +1 -> cash, <= -1 -> 100% equal-weight long basket, else 50%; whole book at 3x.

backtest.period: 2023-01-01 - 2026-10-14 (22 Hyperliquid perps; signal needs 500 + 365 days of history)
backtest.caveat: Promising, not proven: Sharpe 1.01 but the 95% CI touches zero (-0.01..2.04), placebo p = 0.07, only ~11 switches in 3.8 years, and the walk-forward (window/threshold picked on the past) made Sharpe 0.34. The edge is mostly 2023 and the 2025 crash it sat out. Long-only: correlates 0.6-0.7 with the trend books. 3x is the top of the growth curve; it cost an 88% drawdown in the backtest.

boost.why: leverage lives in the plugin (LEV 3x = backtest growth peak: 66%/yr, max DD 88%); kill at 95% like every boosted book

ideas.name: Basis-Momentum: rising premium long, falling premium short (1x, probation) - Strategy 27
ideas.source: Boons & Prado, 'Basis-Momentum', Journal of Finance 74(1) 2019 (https://doi.org/10.1111/jofi.12738); Chi, Hao, Hu & Ran, J. Futures Markets 43(8) 2023
ideas.rule: Mondays 00:00 UTC: BM = 7-day mean hourly perp premium minus the same mean 4 weeks earlier; long the 30% highest BM, short the 30% lowest, equal weight, dollar-neutral, 1x; hold a week.
